issues.explanation: No production code without a test violated: new controllers, routes and verification logic have no test-first coverage.
Password update validates three fields inline instead of using a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.

conventions.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:125 inline validate with 3 fields vs Form Request; no tests despite conventions.md TDD always rule; CHANGELOG.md:26 docs kept in sync followed

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:92 create/store/edit/update small focused methods with PHPDoc; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:50 clear id/hash check; views use {{ }} escaping

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:652-669 guest routes password.request/email/reset/update + verification.verify auth+signed+throttle:6,1; app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:103-112 always back()->with(status, passwords.sent); app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:127-137 strong password rules; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:54-57 403 check + redirect /; lang/pt_BR.json:217,225 subjects; config/mail.php:200-206 theme pegafila + pegafila.css:577-584 #0f7490 button

scope.evidence: .env.example:6-14 locale/name pins; phpunit.xml:237-239 three pins; routes, controllers, views/auth/*, pegafila.css, lang entries, User MustVerifyEmail all serve task; no login/registration/Livewire/ui.php/nginx changes

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR password-reset and email-verification flow with correct routes, validation, theme and translations. Blocked from approval because it ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests despite the mandatory test-first convention.
